correctness.rationale: The primary Faber–Grantham–Howe article and source list give all 31 distinct F5-isomorphism classes. Every class and all 31 projective rational lines are exhaustively evaluated by geometric intersection evenness (finite multiplicities plus infinity). A second coefficient-square test, using squares of every binary quadratic modulo five, independently reproduces each of 31 counts, the histogram and unique Fermat maximizer. Smoothness/pointlessness of the 31 curves are source premises, not assumed from experimental point counts; square descent from geometric evenness is valid over the perfect field F5. Verification scripts replay successfully from extracted final package.
